basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI GTM Product Owner · Sales Enablement & Transformation · Founder · MBA
basics.summary: Functional AI product owner for GTM. At LumApps owns company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement, and built AI Brain (the intelligent context layer that powers internal agents across product, sales, and CS). At Beekeeper shipped GenAI demo content from Salesforce data, an AI Onboarding Specialist that cut time-to-first-value without adding headcount, and replaced $337K in vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks. 13+ years translating cutting-edge AI into measurable business outcomes (revenue, cost avoidance, deal velocity), founder of three companies, MBA-trained on saying no to low-value experiments and steering leadership toward high-impact structural change.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement. Acts as the AI product owner for GTM: ideates with business leaders, prioritises the use case backlog, and reports to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Owns company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement. Bridges engineering, product, and revenue; reports directly to C-level on outcomes.

Built AI Brain, the intelligent context layer that unifies conversation data, usage analytics, and notes into the single source of truth powering internal agents across product, sales, and CS. Structured to prevent hallucinations.

Built and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales (the Deal Velocity use case). 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day; forecast $4M in approved opportunities per quarter.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead and AI builder for GTM. Co-owned launches with Product and Sales, instrumented for ROI, and shipped AI into the revenue motion: content creation, onboarding, translation, sales demos.
highlights: Built GenAI demo system for Sales: auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built for that customer. Content creation use case, measurable lift in demo speed and close rates.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist giving every new signup personalized, high-touch setup guidance. 100% of customers guided through onboarding, time-to-first-value reduced (speed to productivity of new users) without adding headcount.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation contract with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated since Jan 2024. Hard cost avoidance, tool rationalization, instrumented for QBR-ready ROI reporting.

Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Employee Referral, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week whether it moved the needle.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Advises on AI strategy, GTM measurement, and shipping high-ROI initiatives instead of low-value experiments.
highlights: Mentored portfolio companies on AI strategy, technical hiring, and building cultures that ship measurable outcomes rather than science projects.
Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built every layer of the stack and partnered with enterprise customers on go-to-market.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight an instrumented test of product-market fit.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: Research engineer on Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems. Foundational AI work that underpins current LLM and agentic systems craft.
highlights: Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research, work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI.

Compliance-first design: regulatory guardrails for both jurisdictions built before features.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Sr. Manager, AI GTM Strategy & Enablement
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Functional AI Product Owner for the GTM function (Sales, Solutions Consulting, Value Consulting, Professional Services, CS, Sales Ops, Sales Enablement, Customer Support, Alliances). Bridges GTM and the Enterprise AI Hub. Owns the AI Operating Model: backlog prioritisation, knowledge base ownership ('Reltio Brain'), ROI/value realization framework, QBRs to GTM leadership and CIO. Drives measurable outcomes: deal velocity, sales efficiency, enablement speed, message compliance, speed to productivity, tool rationalization. Requires MBA preferred, 13+ years B2B/SaaS revenue + Sales Ops/Digital Transformation/Product Strategy, builder mindset, AI fluency (agents, context windows, model strategy), Python/Zapier for prototyping. US-based, $138k-$283k.
_jobApplication.notes: Very strong fit. AI Brain at LumApps = direct parallel to 'Reltio Brain' / Sources of Truth. AI Onboarding Specialist hits 'speed to productivity' use case. GenAI demo from Salesforce hits 'Content Creation'. $337K vendor takeout = ROI/cost avoidance proof. AI outbound agents = Deal Velocity use case. Three founded companies + MBA = builder/strategist combo. Gap: US-based role, candidate in Zurich - flag visa/relocation. Title is Sr. Manager (vs JD body saying Director - JD seems inconsistent); positioned for Sr. Manager.
